name: team_id_mapping
description: Bridge table: our team_id <-> Big Balls Sports Data's bbs_team_id, one row per team. Matched by normalized full team name, not abbreviation - their canonical short_name differs from our tricode for 5 franchises (GS/NO/SA/UTAH/WSH vs our GSW/NOP/SAS/UTA/WAS). All 30 teams matched.

name: team_name_full
description: Team's full name (e.g. 'Golden State Warriors') - the join key used to build this mapping, since abbreviations differ between the two sources for 5 franchises.

name: bbs_team_id
description: This team's id in Big Balls Sports Data's system (UUID) - unrelated to our own numeric team_id.
logic: Matched by normalized full team name.

name: bbs_short_name
description: Team abbreviation as Big Balls Sports Data spells it - differs from our team_abbreviation for 5 teams (GS/NO/SA/UTAH/WSH vs our GSW/NOP/SAS/UTA/WAS).
